purpose: Flag likely Standard Estonian inflectional and lexical leakage in intended Võro text.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian active past participle -nud. Võro expects -nU(q), practical -nu/-nü or -nuq/-nüq (e.g. olnu/olnuq, saanu/saanuq).
rules.hint: Rewrite the verb as a Võro past participle (-nu/-nü/-nuq/-nüq), not Estonian -nud.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian passive past participle -tud/-dud. Võro uses passive past sg -t/-d (-tu/-du) and plural -tU(q)/-dU(q).
rules.hint: Check whether the Võro form should end in -t/-d, -tu/-tü, or -du/-dü (with optional -q).

rules.message: Looks like Estonian past negation: ei + -nud/-tud. Võro past negation uses es (e.g. es tiiq, es olõq) or fused/postposed -Vs (olõ-õs).
rules.hint: Use Võro past negation es + connegative or -Vs, not Estonian ei teinud / ei olnud.

rules.message: Standard Estonian contracted negation pole/polnud/poleks/polevat is foreign to Võro.
rules.hint: Use Võro olõ-õi / ei olõq (present), es olõq / olõ-õs (past), or es olõssi (conditional).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian 3rd singular present -b. Võro 3sg present is endingless or -s-final (kirotas, eläs, tulõ, and), not -b.
rules.hint: Check whether this should be an endingless or -s-conjugation Võro 3sg verb.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian 3rd plural present -vad. Võro 3pl present is -vAq/-sEq (practical -vaq/-väq or -sõq/-seq).
rules.hint: Use a Võro 3pl ending (-vaq/-väq or -sõq/-seq), not Estonian -vad.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian impersonal present -takse/-dakse. Võro impersonal present is -tAs/-dAs (e.g. tetäs, loetas).
rules.hint: Rewrite as a Võro passive/impersonal form (-tas/-täs/-das/-däs).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian simple past personal ending -sin/-sime/-site.
rules.hint: Use the Võro simple past paradigm (-i/-si + -miq/-tiq or palatalization/s-less 1sg).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian conditional personal ending -ksin/-ksime/-ksite. Võro conditional uses -si/-ssi/-ssiq or -nu/-nü.
rules.hint: Rewrite with Võro conditional morphology (-si/-ssi).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian illative -sse. Võro illative uses -he, -de/-te, or short/geminate illative forms (e.g. tarrõ, liina, mõtsa).
rules.hint: Check the Võro illative form (-he/-de/-te or short illative).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian plural illative -desse/-tesse.
rules.hint: Use Võro plural illative (-ihe/-he or type-specific plural stem).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian plural partitive or 2sg past ending -sid. Võro plural partitive uses -sit/-it/-id, vowel plural, or isi/idsi.
rules.hint: Check whether this should be a Võro plural partitive or 2sg past form.

rules.message: Looks like an Estonian da-/ta-infinitive without glottal stop q. Võro infinitives keep -daq/-taq/-aq/-q in standard orthography.
rules.hint: If this is an infinitive, check the Võro infinitive form (-daq/-taq/-aq).

rules.message: Looks like Estonian -mas supine inessive. Võro supine inessive is -mAn (practical -man/-män or -mah/-mäh).
rules.hint: Check whether this should be Võro -man/-män (or -mah).

rules.message: Looks like Estonian -maks translative supine. Võro uses -mAs/-mäs or a purpose clause (et + conditional/infinitive).
rules.hint: Rewrite with Võro supine/purpose syntax.

rules.message: Looks like Estonian -mata supine abessive. Võro supine abessive is -mAldA (e.g. -malda/-mäldä, -maldaq).
rules.hint: Check whether this should be Võro -malda/-mäldä.

rules.message: Looks like Estonian -des/-tes gerund. Võro gerundive uses -dEn/-tEn/-n (e.g. kõnõldõn, visatõn).
rules.hint: Check whether this should be a Võro -dõn/-ten/-n gerundive.

rules.message: May be Estonian nominative plural -d. Võro nominative plural is normally -q (or vowel-harmonized forms without -d).
rules.hint: Only flag if plural nominative; partitive singular forms like tuud/muud/tüüd/hääd naturally end in -d.

rules.message: May be Estonian translative -ks. Võro translative is normally -s (e.g. suurusõs, pääväs).
rules.hint: Check whether this is a noun/adjective needing Võro -s translative.

rules.message: May be Estonian essive -na. Traditional Võro expresses essive relations via -st/-s or postpositions rather than productive -nA.
rules.hint: Soft reminder; verify it is not a lexical word ending in -na.

rules.message: Common Standard Estonian adverb/pronoun leaked into Võro text.
rules.hint: Consider Võro equivalents: põrõhõlla/noq/nüüt, väega/väegaq, pallo, midägi, kinkagi, minkperäst, kuis.

do_not_flag_suffixes.reason: Estonian comitative -ga overlaps with practical Võro comitative -ga / -gaq.
Estonian terminative -ni overlaps with Võro terminative -ni / -niq.
